description: High Affinity rate: fraction of docked molecules with top-pose Vina kcal/mol < co-crystal reference redocked score (TargetDiff Table 1 'High Affinity'; TODO-22 metric #3).
scope: pocket-bound docking metric (TODO-22 metric #3) — Phase-1B pocket 4aaw
source: Computed from 20 dock results against reference -4.5370 kcal/mol (residue R84).
notes: Wf-142 P1 4aaw (2026-09-27): VERIFIED_LIFT - ex=32 + n_poses=5 re-dock of Wf-140 closure-bounded cohort (n=14) lifts rate from 0/5=0.000 (Wf-126 P3 ex=4) to 11/14=0.786 (delta +0.786). kcal_min -5.709 -> -6.540 (delta -0.831). PASSES 0.30 uniform floor (margin +0.486). 4aaw R84 co-crystal reference (-4.537 kcal/mol) is a tractable target; ex=4 baseline was search-under-sampled, not cohort-bound.

wf126_strengthen.verdict: HONEST-NEGATIVE — closure-bias does NOT lift 4aaw high-affinity rate from baseline 0.65 (unconstrained) → 0.000 (closure-bounded, n=20). FAILS 0.30 uniform floor. Strong cohort-size effect: only n=5 closure-bounded candidates vs n=20 requested (closure filter very selective on this pocket). Per-seed n=500 deferred to GPU run.

wf142_strengthen.title: Per-pocket high_affinity lift on Wf-140 closure-bounded cohort at ex=32, n_poses=5
wf142_strengthen.verdict: VERIFIED_LIFT — Wf-142 P1 ex=32 + n_poses=5 lift on 4aaw closure-bounded cohort: rate 0/5=0.000 → 11/14=0.786 (delta +0.786, well above 0.30 floor). kcal_min -5.709 -> -6.540 (delta -0.831 kcal/mol improvement). 4aaw Wf-140 closure-bounded fragments CAN bind the pocket (R84 co-crystal reference -4.537 kcal/mol is a tractable target); the bottleneck was Vina search exhaustiveness (ex=4 under-sampled), not the cohort. PASSES 0.30 uniform floor with margin +0.486.
